name: Wild Rides: WaterPark Factory
summary:
Wild Rides: WaterPark Factory is a game where the player can build a custom water park by constructing a waterslide. There are three levels represented through a different location: Slippery Swamp, Seasick Island or Texas Hills. The game does not focus on managing a park, but rather the design of the slides.

Players can freely move the camera and use different pieces to create a slide. To succeed, it needs to be tested by different people that each have a different personality. Once it is built a test can be performed, showing the character from behind going down the slide. Emojis show how that character experiences the ride and adjustments can be made to improve their satisfaction. A ride can be made too dangerous or fast, causing the character to fly out of the ride.
